title: Stopwatch with Start, Stop, Lap, and Reset Preemption
description: Digital chronometer modeled in Esterel using suspend/when for pause-resume control, parallel lap-freeze display handling, and strong abort reset preemption.
code:
% Digital Stopwatch with Start/Stop, Lap Freeze, and Strong Reset Preemption
module Stopwatch:
input TICK, START_STOP, LAP, RESET;
output DISPLAY_TICK, LAP_FROZEN, CLEARED;
relation START_STOP # RESET;

loop
  abort
    [
      loop
        await START_STOP;
        abort
          every TICK do
            emit DISPLAY_TICK
          end
        when START_STOP;
        pause
      end
    ||
      loop
        await LAP;
        abort
          sustain LAP_FROZEN
        when LAP;
        pause
      end
    ]
  when RESET do
    emit CLEARED
  end;
  pause
end
end module

title: Elevator Door Obstruction and Timeout Controller
description: Reactive elevator cabin door controller handling open requests, dwell timer expiration, optical light-curtain obstruction reversal via trap/exit, and motor commands.
code:
% Elevator Door Obstruction Reversal and Timeout Reactive Controller
module ElevatorDoor:
input OPEN_REQ, DOOR_OPENED, DOOR_CLOSED, OBSTRUCT, DWELL_DONE;
output MOTOR_OPEN, MOTOR_CLOSE, CHIME;
relation DOOR_OPENED # DOOR_CLOSED;

loop
  await OPEN_REQ;
  trap CYCLE_DONE in
    loop
      abort
        sustain MOTOR_OPEN
      when DOOR_OPENED;
      emit CHIME;
      await DWELL_DONE;
      abort
        sustain MOTOR_CLOSE
      when DOOR_CLOSED or OBSTRUCT do
        present DOOR_CLOSED then
          exit CYCLE_DONE
        else
          pause
        end
      end
    end
  end;
  pause
end
end module

title: Avionics Cockpit Display Mode Manager
description: Multi-file avionics primary flight display mode manager composing a reusable alarm-acknowledgement submodule (alarm_handler.strl) via Esterel run signal renaming and mode preemption.
code:
% Avionics Cockpit Display Mode Manager with Master Caution Alarm Submodule
module AlarmHandler:
input FAULT_IN, ACK_BTN, FAULT_CLEARED;
output MASTER_WARN, AUDIO_TONE;

loop
  await FAULT_IN;
  abort
    [
      sustain MASTER_WARN
    ||
      abort
        sustain AUDIO_TONE
      when ACK_BTN
    ]
  when FAULT_CLEARED;
  pause
end
end module

module CockpitDisplayManager:
input MODE_NAV, MODE_ENG, FAULT_ENG, MASTER_ACK, FAULT_OK, POWER_RST;
output SHOW_NAV, SHOW_ENG, WARN_LAMP, CHIME_OUT;
relation MODE_NAV # MODE_ENG;

loop
  abort
    [
      loop
        abort
          sustain SHOW_NAV
        when MODE_ENG;
        abort
          sustain SHOW_ENG
        when MODE_NAV;
        pause
      end
    ||
      run AlarmHandler [
        signal FAULT_ENG / FAULT_IN,
               MASTER_ACK / ACK_BTN,
               FAULT_OK / FAULT_CLEARED,
               WARN_LAMP / MASTER_WARN,
               CHIME_OUT / AUDIO_TONE
      ]
    ]
  when POWER_RST;
  pause
end
end module
